scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply msv-local --local --config wrangler.worker.jsonc
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build && wrangler dev --config wrangler.worker.jsonc
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run check && wrangler deploy --env staging --config wrangler.worker.jsonc
scripts.dev:pages: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist
